newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks advance in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks advance in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly weak but soon began advancing in early Thursday morning trade.
Financial sector issues continued to attract buyers, offsetting losses from blue chips, brokers said.
After nearly 20 minutes of trade the Nikkei 225 average was up 55.61 points or 0.31 percent at 18,086.81. Its June futures were 70 points higher at 18,110.
Brokers said the market was mostly impassive towards Japan trade surplus data for fiscal 1996/97, which were released shortly before the market opened.
